main_log_level.description: Log verbosity: ERR, WARN, INFO, or DEBUG.

main_log_domains.description: Bitmask for filtering log messages by domain (e.g., 0x00000001 = general, 0x00000002 = GSM, etc.).

main_enable_plugins.description: Plugins to enable explicitly (e.g., ['mbim', 'qmi']). If non-empty, only these are loaded.

main_filter_policy.description: Specify which ports are probed and how: 'ALLOWLIST-ONLY' or 'STRICT'.

main_no_auto_scan.description: Fully disable udev-based auto-scan looking for devices.

modem_overrides.description: Per-modem configuration overrides. Each item defines settings for a specific modem, matched by hardware/firmware identifiers or port patterns.

removed.description: Whether ModemManager service is enabled at startup.

main_modem_timeout.description: Seconds to wait before giving up on modem initialization.

main_max_connection_attempts.description: Maximum attempts to connect to a modem before marking it failed.

main_allowed_vendor_ids.description: List of allowed hardware vendor IDs in hex (e.g., ['0x12d1']). Used only if vendor whitelist mode is active.

main_forbidden_vendor_ids.description: List of forbidden hardware vendor IDs in hex. Overrides allowed list.

main_allowed_device_ids.description: List of allowed hardware device IDs in hex, per vendor (space-separated hex vendor+device pairs like '12d1:1506').

main_forbidden_device_ids.description: List of forbidden hardware device IDs in hex. Overrides allowed list.

modem_overrides_items.description: Unique ID for this override (e.g., 'modem-1', or filename-like). Used as section header.

modem_overrides_items_enabled.description: Enable this specific modem (overrides global Enabled setting).

port_types.description: Port types to probe, in order.

scan_ports.description: Whether to scan all ports (true) or only those explicitly listed.

no_sim.description: Skip SIM probing for this modem.

no_ppp.description: Disable PPP (Point-to-Point Protocol) for this modem.
